items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, my wife knows the date, knows the year. ... But Aline, I'm going to just whisper. Eileen.

ctx.x: Marches and stuff, with the band, in the army

Yeah, and I started playing Broadway musicals when I came out. No, wait a minute, now, I really can't remember that. Aline, do you know when I started playing musicals? I got it in my wallet. I have it in my wallet, right back there, all the shows I ever did. It's 19 -- I think, yeah, -- oh, no.
